newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rice tender attracts 41 exporters.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rice tender attracts 41 exporters.

text.p: Forty-one exporters have tendered for 50,000 tonnes of rice for October/November delivery to Sri Lanka, the state buying arm Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (CWE) said on Wednesday.
"(The tender) will be awarded within the course of this week," a CWE official told Reuters.
Government officials have said Sri Lanka plans to import up to 400,000 tonnes of rice by the end of this year to meet a crop shortfall caused by drought and rising demand.
